name: Advanced Storytelling

prompts.header: Each part of your portfolio starts with a compact header. Name the stage plainly, so a marker can find it at a glance.
prompts.text: Show your process, not just the result. What did you try, what did you learn, and what evidence (sketches, drafts, data) shows it? Cite sources as (Author Year).
prompts.media: Process evidence counts: drafts, contact sheets, screenshots of edits. Caption each one with what it shows about your decisions.
prompts.scrolly: Why does this need to scroll? Each step should reveal one new thing, at a pace you chose on purpose. Say why in your effect and step choices.
prompts.references: List every source you cite in the text, in Harvard style, and cite every source you list.

reflection: What was your idea at the start, and how did it change?
Which technique did you try for the first time, and what did you learn from it?
What feedback did you get, and what did you do with it?
What would you do differently next time?
